entities.summary: Ettal Abbey is a Benedictine monastery in the village of Ettal close to Oberammergau and Garmisch-Partenkirchen in Bavaria, Germany. With a community of more than 50 monks, with another five at Wechselburg, the Abbey is one of the largest Benedictine houses and is a major attraction for visitors. Ettal Abbey is a abbey in Ettal, established in 1301. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
